turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Can I ask something off the record?
Nothing here is off the record. Who entered the zero?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned. Twice now you've dodged me, Hale.
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
You just called my son a cheater. He doesn't lie, and he didn't cheat. Say that again and we finish this in the principal's office.
